_about: The messy set (PLAN-launch L0.5): 40 sentences written for this comparison on Nov 13, 2026, after the cleanup rules, and never used to tune them. 'say' is what is spoken (fillers, stutters, false starts, spoken numbers); 'meant' is what the speaker wanted on the page. Scored by bench/compare.py on edits needed: the words a person would still have to change to get from the output to 'meant'.
